Fed & Policy Watch
  • SOFR was 3.94% effective Nov 24; NFCI was -0.444 for the week ending Nov 20; MOVE 97.54 and the 10-year Treasury 4.85% are Nov 25 observations. Measures are asynchronous, not live. Chicago Fed lists the next NFCI release date as Dec 2, but its checked release calendar does not specify a time.
  • The Board identifies Thanksgiving, Nov 26, as a holiday and says daily and weekly statistical releases scheduled that day move to Friday, Nov 27; H.4.1 is listed Friday at 4:30 PM ET. The next FOMC decision is Dec 9 at 2:00 PM ET, followed by the press conference at 2:30 PM; minutes are Dec 30 at 2:00 PM.
  • Energy schedules: EIA petroleum reports use the standard Wednesday 10:30 AM ET time, with no exception listed for Dec 2; natural gas storage uses the standard Thursday 10:30 AM ET time for Dec 3. Thanksgiving-week natural gas was explicitly moved to Wed Nov 25 at noon and is elapsed. No exchange-hours claim is made.
  • TreasuryDirect lists competitive bids closing at 11:30 AM ET for 13- and 26-week bills on Nov 30 and a 6-week bill on Dec 1. Dates and times are in the calendar.
Omissions and Watch
  • Calendar conflict check: the prior briefing carried a Dec 2 PCE date, while the currently checked BEA schedule lists Personal Income and Outlays for November on Dec 23 at 8:30 AM; the New York Fed December calendar also places Personal Income and the PCE Deflator on Dec 23 at 8:30 AM. No Dec 2 PCE release is confirmed by the checked BEA schedule, so it is not listed. The prior New York Fed Nov 25 PCE listing is elapsed and was not repeated.
  • The Chicago Fed release calendar confirms an NFCI release on Dec 2 but gives no exact time in the checked calendar; it is noted in Fed watch rather than shown as a timed calendar event. Event periods are not inferred where sources do not provide them.
  • Calendar checked: New York Fed November and December Economic Indicators calendars; Federal Reserve Board November and December calendars; BEA schedule; Census 2026 calendar; Chicago Fed release calendar and NFCI CSV; TreasuryDirect upcoming auctions; EIA petroleum and natural-gas schedules; U.S. Treasury daily yield CSV. BLS pages were not requested; BLS dates and times use the New York Fed calendar as instructed. Yahoo Finance is a single quote source. Selected events only, not every event on every checked calendar.
  • No verified unscheduled policy or geopolitical watch item from this run; this was not a full headline-risk review. Material verified items are the Treasury bill supply, Thanksgiving release shifts, scheduled EIA reports, and the December policy and inflation calendar. No CME holiday-session hours were independently verified.
Trading Strategy Note | ES Futures
BASE CASE
SPY ended Wednesday down 0.29%, while ES is higher overnight; VIX is 28.29, MOVE is 97.54 and the 10-year yield is 4.85%. The volatility gauges disagree with a low-risk assumption, and the Thanksgiving holiday may leave liquidity conditions atypical; no exchange-hours inference is made. The next verified catalysts include Friday claims and Census data, bill auctions, the December employment report and FOMC decision, followed by CPI. Let price and rates react to scheduled events before taking a directional view; one overnight quote is not confirmation. Scenario framing only, not a trade signal.
INVALIDATION
Reassess a cautious/neutral scenario if ES and Treasury yields move decisively together after verified data or supply events, or if volatility broadens rather than easing. Do not use unsupported price levels or targets. Refresh quotes and verify contract specifications and market liquidity before execution.
